packageRules.description: One PR for the DSPy tooling's Python dependencies, as Dependabot's pip group did
One PR for Dockerfile base-image bumps, as Dependabot's docker group did; base images are pinned by digest
Self-built LAN registry images are bumped by their own release pipelines, not Renovate
One PR for the Dockerfile's step-cli-build stage, so a step-cli release, its commit and the Go module pins it bumps move together

customManagers.description: Dockerfile ARG pins annotated with a `# renovate:` comment (step-cli's Go module bumps, gh)
The step-cli-build stage's release tag and the commit it must resolve to
matchStrings:
# renovate: smallstep/cli release tag and its commit[^
]*
ARG STEP_CLI_VERSION=(?<currentValue>\S+)
ARG STEP_CLI_COMMIT=(?<currentDigest>[0-9a-f]{40})
